comparison.objective: Select water rather than look-alike acetone and place it on a hotplate, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe beaker transport differs from hex-bit alignment, captive-screw manipulation, fine rotary setting, socket reacquisition, and iterative mechanical commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Success requires an upright released water beaker while acetone stays at least 7.5 cm away; the candidate requires two force- and travel-bounded impact cycles without setting drift.
comparison.reason: The shared safety theme is generic; substance selection and placement do not test the candidate's adjustment-and-validation ability.
